description: Creates an automation flow and, optionally, its first operations in the same call. trigger selects what starts the flow (manual, schedule, event, webhook) and options carries the trigger-specific configuration, so a schedule flow needs its cron expression in options. A flow created with status active starts reacting immediately, events included, so create it inactive when that is not wanted. Each operations entry needs key, type and editor coordinates; operations are created but not chained, so wire the resolve and reject paths with update_flow or in the admin app. Use update_flow to change a flow and trigger_flow to run one.

folder.description: Directus 12.4+: flow folder ID to file the flow under (omit for root)

operations.description: Initial operations to create with the flow

trigger.description: Trigger type (e.g., manual, schedule, event, webhook)

name: create_flow
